abilities.name: Ten Shadows Technique
abilities.description: Allows Megumi to summon shikigami through shadows and manipulate shadows to hide or store objects.

abilities.name: Divine Dogs
abilities.description: Twin canine shikigami used for tracking and close-range attacks.

abilities.name: Nue
abilities.description: A winged shikigami that can fly and emit electricity.

abilities.name: Max Elephant
abilities.description: An elephant shikigami that produces a large volume of water and attacks with its weight.

abilities.name: Rabbit Escape
abilities.description: A swarm of rabbit shikigami used for distraction and reconnaissance.

abilities.name: Mahoraga
abilities.description: The most powerful Ten Shadows shikigami, capable of adapting to phenomena.

abilities.name: Expert Weapons Specialist
abilities.description: Megumi can store and switch weapons through his shadows.

domain.name: Chimera Shadow Garden
abilities: Floods the area with fluid shadows that can rapidly produce shikigami.
Enhances the Ten Shadows Technique to 120% of its potential.
Allows Megumi to create shadow clones of himself and additional shikigami.
The incomplete domain has no sure-hit effect and requires an indoor space to enclose a target.
